row: Andrea (Postolka) Barton is licensed through Equissage™ as an Equine and Canine Sports Massage Therapist, is an Equi-Tape™ Practitioner and has received her A.A.S. Degree in Horse Science Technology through Kirkwood Community College in 2016. Andrea has worked with horses of many different breeds, disciplines and ages and strives to provide quality work at an affordable rate!
